LanguageData.HE_Faction_Roma.label: Nova Roma Republic
LanguageData.HE_Faction_Roma.description: The citizens of Nova Roma, heirs of the colony ship Aeternitas. Their legions march in step, their roads run straight and their senate never forgets an insult or a debt.
LanguageData.HE_Player_Roma.label: Nova Roman settlers
LanguageData.HE_Player_Roma.description: A small band of Nova Roman citizens founding a new colonia far from the senate.
